```{r}

library(corrplot)

         method = "color",

         tl.col = "black",
         tl.srt = 45)

```

```{r}
library(powertools)

n_total <- 192
dropout <- 0.10
n_eff <- n_total * (1 - dropout)
alpha <- 0.05
power_target <- 0.8
predictor_set <- 3:8 
r_range <- seq(0.1, 0.7, by = 0.1) # partial correlation range

results <- sapply(predictor_set, function(k) {
  sapply(r_range, function(r) {
    mlrF.partial(
      N = n_eff,
      p = k,
      q = 1, 
      pc = r,   # partial correlation
      alpha = alpha,
      power = NULL 
    )
  })
})

results_df <- as.data.frame(results)
colnames(results_df) <- paste0("k=", predictor_set)
rownames(results_df) <- paste0("r=", r_range)

results_df
```

```{r}
alpha <- 0.05
power_target <- 0.8
predictor_set <- 3:8  
r_range <- seq(0.1, 0.7, by = 0.1)  # partial correlation range
q <- 1                         # only test the first predictor

results <- sapply(predictor_set, function(k) {
  sapply(r_range, function(r) {
    mlrF.partial(
      N = NULL,  
      p = k,
      q = q,
      pc = r,     # partial correlation
      alpha = alpha,
      power = power_target
    )
  })
})

results_df <- as.data.frame(results)
colnames(results_df) <- paste0("k=", predictor_set)
rownames(results_df) <- paste0("r=", r_range)

results_df
```
